string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_execution_summary
string.translation: Use input for selected text. Return a string to commit it. Each tap starts a fresh QuickJS runtime.

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_execution_dialog_message
string.translation:
Use input to read the current selection. If nothing is selected, input is an empty string.

Return a string to commit it to the editor. Returning null, undefined, or nothing finishes without commit.

Global JavaScript runs before the slot body on every key press.

The slot body and Global JavaScript share the same execution, but every tap creates a fresh QuickJS runtime and context. Do not rely on state from an earlier run.

If Global JavaScript needs input, define a helper there and pass input into it from the slot body.

This environment is synchronous-only. DOM, Node.js APIs, fetch, and async request pipelines are not available.

可用 input 讀取目前選取中的文字；如果沒有選字，input 就是空字串。

return 字串時，會把它送到 editor；回傳 null、undefined，或根本沒有 return，都會完成但不送出。

每次按鍵都會先跑 Global JavaScript，再在同一次 execution 內跑 slot body。

slot body 和 Global JavaScript 共用同一次執行，但每次點按都會建立新的 QuickJS runtime / context，不會保留上一輪留下的狀態。

如果 Global JavaScript 需要處理 input，請在那裡定義 helper，並從 slot body 把 input 傳進去。

這個環境只支援同步執行；沒有 DOM、Node.js API、fetch，也沒有 async request pipeline。

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_return_summary
string.translation: Only non-null return values commit text, and commit is skipped if InputConnection changed during execution.
只有非 null 的回傳值才會 commit，而且執行期間若 InputConnection 改變，就會跳過 commit。

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_return_dialog_message
string.translation:
Return contract:
- return a non-null and non-undefined value to commit it as text
- return null, return undefined, or omit return to finish without commit

Even after a successful run, text only commits when the InputConnection at the end is still the same object captured at the start. Focus changes or editor switches fail closed.

回傳規則：
- 回傳非 null 且非 undefined 的值時，會先轉成字串再 commit
- 回傳 null、回傳 undefined，或根本沒有 return，都會成功結束但不 commit

即使腳本成功跑完，也只有在結束時的 InputConnection 還是啟動時那個同一個 object 時才會 commit。若焦點切換或 editor 改變，就會 fail closed。

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_http_summary
string.translation: Beyond standard QuickJS features, this patch also provides input, httpRequest(options), httpGet(url), and httpPost(url, body).
除了標準 QuickJS 功能外，這個 patch 另外提供 input、httpRequest(options)、httpGet(url) 與 httpPost(url, body)。

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_http_dialog_message
string.translation:
Beyond standard QuickJS features, this patch provides these extra host APIs:
- input
- httpRequest(options)
- httpGet(url)
- httpPost(url, body)

httpRequest only accepts GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE. Only http:// and https:// URLs are allowed. headers must be a plain object, and body is sent as UTF-8.

Non-2xx status, invalid method, invalid URL scheme, timeout, invalid headers, transport errors, and response bodies over the configured limit all throw script errors.

除了標準 QuickJS 功能外，這個 patch 額外提供下面這些 API：
- input
- httpRequest(options)
- httpGet(url)
- httpPost(url, body)

httpRequest 只接受 GET、POST、PUT、PATCH、DELETE，URL 只允許 http:// 與 https://。headers 必須是 plain object，body 會以 UTF-8 傳送。

非 2xx status、無效 method、無效 URL scheme、timeout、無效 headers、transport error，以及超過 response body limit 的回應，都會直接 throw script error。

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_limits_summary
string.translation: Slots are clamped by global timeout, response, memory, and stack limits; syntax and runtime errors fail only that run.
slot 會受全域 timeout、response、memory、stack 限制，syntax 與 runtime error 只會讓該次執行失敗。

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_limits_dialog_message
string.translation:
Runtime limits:
- slot timeoutMs input must stay within 0..global timeoutMaxMs; after sanitize the runtime minimum is 1 ms
- response body limit, memory limit, and max stack come from JavaScript Runtime Limits

Defaults:
- timeoutMaxMs: 30000 ms
- response body: 1 MiB
- memory: 8 MiB
- max stack: 512 KiB

Syntax errors, runtime errors, timeouts, HTTP failures, oversized responses, and InputConnection changes fail closed for the current run only. They do not disable the whole Custom Top Row feature.

執行限制：
- slot 的 timeoutMs 輸入值只能在 0..全域 timeoutMaxMs 內；sanitize 後的執行期最小值仍是 1 ms
- response body limit、memory limit、max stack 都來自 JavaScript Runtime Limits

預設值：
- timeoutMaxMs：30000 ms
- response body：1 MiB
- memory：8 MiB
- max stack：512 KiB

syntax error、runtime error、timeout、HTTP 失敗、response 過大，以及 commit 前 InputConnection 改變，都只會讓當次執行 fail closed，不會把整個自訂第一排按鍵功能停掉。

string.name: gboard_patches_clipboard_card_preview_limit_summary
string.translation: Gboard puts the entire text into each card on the Clipboard page and renders it repeatedly, which can make vertical scrolling stutter. This switch makes each clipboard card actually hold only the first 1,000 characters while it is rendered to avoid scrolling lag.
由於 Gboard 官方在剪貼簿頁面中會把整個 text 放在卡片中並且重複渲染，會導致上下滑動卡頓，所以這個開關會讓剪貼簿卡片實際只存前 1000 字元，避免上下滑動卡頓。

string.name: gboard_patches_clipboard_show_sensitive_content_summary
string.translation: Show the original text instead of dots for clipboard items marked sensitive by password managers, incognito browsing, or other apps. This can expose passwords and private data on screen.
對密碼管理器、無痕瀏覽或其他 App 標記為敏感的剪貼簿項目，顯示原始文字而非圓點。這可能會讓密碼與私人資料直接顯示在畫面上。

string.name: gboard_patches_clipboard_content_limit_summary
string.translation: Customize the maximum character count for each text clipboard item. Official default: 20000
自訂每個文字剪貼簿項目的最大字元數。官方預設為20000

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_show_expiry_countdown_summary
string.translation: Shows the remaining retention time above each clipboard item.
在每個剪貼簿項目上方顯示剩餘保留時間。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_show_creation_time_summary
string.translation: Shows when each clipboard item was created in the current device time zone.
以目前裝置時區顯示每個剪貼簿項目的建立時間。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_show_order_index_summary
string.translation: Shows [1], [2], and so on above each clipboard item.
在每個剪貼簿項目上方顯示 [1]、[2] 等標記。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_order_index_direction_summary
string.translation: Controls whether [1] marks the newest or oldest clipboard item.
控制 [1] 代表最新還是最舊的剪貼簿項目。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_clipboard_columns_summary
string.translation: Controls how many columns the clipboard grid uses.
控制剪貼簿網格使用幾欄。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_content_max_lines_summary
string.translation: Controls how many preview lines each clipboard item can show before truncation.
控制每個剪貼簿項目在截斷前最多顯示幾行預覽文字。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_ttl_summary
string.translation: Controls how long unpinned clipboard items are retained.
控制未釘選的剪貼簿項目保留時間。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_max_count_summary
string.translation: Limits how many unpinned clipboard items stay visible at the same time.
限制同時可見的未釘選剪貼簿項目數量。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_summary
string.translation: Zero-install clipboard sharing hosted by this phone. Open the same LAN page on multiple devices to keep your phone and browsers in sync. Recommended: turn on Quick Settings Tile.
由這支手機提供、免安裝的網頁剪貼簿分享功能。在同一個區網中於多個裝置開啟同一個頁面，即可讓手機與瀏覽器保持同步。建議：開啟快速設定磁貼。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_entry_summary
string.translation: Hosted on this phone at %1$s when enabled.
啟用時會在這支手機的 %1$s 提供服務。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_clients_feature_summary
string.translation: View connected Web Clipboard clients and kick browser sessions.
檢視已連線的網頁剪貼簿用戶端並中斷瀏覽器工作階段。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_pairing_error
string.translation: 請輸入 4 位數配對碼。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_pairing_summary
string.translation: Default is on. Desktop browsers must enter a simple 4-digit code before they can sync unless you turn this off.
預設為開啟。桌面瀏覽器在同步前必須輸入簡單的 4 位數配對碼，除非你關閉這個選項。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_pairing_code_summary_on
string.translation: Desktop users enter this 4-digit code or open a URL that includes ?code=%1$s.
桌面使用者必須輸入這組 4 位數配對碼，或開啟包含 ?code=%1$s 的網址。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_pairing_code_summary_off
string.translation: Pairing is off; this code is only used after you enable the switch.
配對功能目前關閉；只有在重新啟用後才會使用這組配對碼。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_port_summary
string.translation: Choose the port used by the phone-hosted web UI.
選擇由手機提供的 Web UI 所使用的連接埠。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_regenerate_code_summary
string.translation: Create a new 4-digit code and restart the portal if it is running.
建立新的 4 位數配對碼，並在入口正在執行時重新啟動服務。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_no_clients
string.translation: 目前沒有瀏覽器用戶端連線。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_clients_summary
string.translation: Tap to view and kick browser clients.
點一下可檢視並中斷瀏覽器用戶端。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_connected_summary
string.translation: Browser clients currently connected to the Web Clipboard portal.
目前連線到網頁剪貼簿入口網站的瀏覽器用戶端。

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_kick_confirm_message
string.translation: 要將 %1$s 從網頁剪貼簿中斷嗎？

string.name: gboard_patches_web_clipboard_qs_recommendation
string.translation: Recommended: turn on Quick Settings Tile.
建議：開啟快速設定磁貼。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_summary
string.translation: Choose whether Gboard settings use the new or legacy settings style.
選擇 Gboard 設定使用新樣式或舊樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_header_summary
string.translation: Control whether Gboard settings use the new or legacy settings experience. Reopen Gboard settings after changing this option.
控制 Gboard 設定使用新的或舊的設定體驗。變更後請重新開啟 Gboard 設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_error_summary
string.translation: The homepage selector failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
首頁切換器載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_safeguard_summary
string.translation: This Android version does not expose the expected expressive runtime. New still remains selectable, but it runs under crash recovery protection.
這個 Android 版本沒有提供預期的 expressive runtime。仍可選擇新樣式，但會受當機復原保護。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_trial_armed_summary
string.translation: Open Gboard settings within %1$d seconds. If nothing launches in that window, it falls back to Legacy automatically.
請在 %1$d 秒內開啟 Gboard 設定。如果在這段時間內沒有成功啟動，會自動回退到舊樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_recovery_summary
string.translation: The previous New settings launch did not finish cleanly. Legacy stays active so you can reopen settings and retry safely.
上一次的新設定樣式啟動沒有正常完成。舊樣式會維持啟用，讓你能安全地重新開啟設定並重試。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_trial_expired_summary
string.translation: The New launch window expired before Gboard opened its settings page. Legacy stays active until you choose New again.
新樣式的啟動視窗已過期，Gboard 尚未成功開啟設定頁。舊樣式會維持啟用，直到你再次選擇新樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new_recovered
string.translation: The previous New launch crashed. Legacy stays active until you switch modes or choose New again to retry.
前一次的新樣式啟動發生當機。舊樣式會維持啟用，直到你切換模式，或再次選擇新樣式重試。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new_expired
string.translation: The New launch window expired. Choose New again, then open Gboard settings within 10 seconds to retry.
新樣式的啟動視窗已過期。請再次選擇新樣式，並在 10 秒內開啟 Gboard 設定重試。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new_armed
string.translation: Open Gboard settings within 10 seconds. If the launch crashes or never starts, it falls back to Legacy automatically.
請在 10 秒內開啟 Gboard 設定。如果啟動當機或沒有成功開始，會自動回退到舊樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new_guarded
string.translation: New stays available on this Android version, but it runs with automatic fallback protection if the settings launch fails.
在這個 Android 版本上仍可使用新樣式，但如果設定啟動失敗，會自動回退保護。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new
string.translation: Always use the new settings style. Reopen Gboard settings to apply.
永遠使用新設定樣式。變更後請重新開啟 Gboard 設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_legacy
string.translation: Always use the legacy settings style. Reopen Gboard settings to apply.
永遠使用舊設定樣式。變更後請重新開啟 Gboard 設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_auto
string.translation: Follow Gboard automatic selection. Reopen Gboard settings after switching modes.
跟隨 Gboard 的自動選擇。切換模式後請重新開啟 Gboard 設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_current_summary_guarded
string.translation: Legacy settings style is active right now because New is being held back by the safety guard.
目前實際啟用的是舊設定樣式，因為安全保護暫時阻擋了新樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_current_summary_queued
string.translation: New settings style is queued for the next Gboard settings launch.
新設定樣式已排入下一次 Gboard 設定啟動。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_current_summary_protected
string.translation: New settings style is selected with crash recovery protection on this Android version.
在這個 Android 版本上已選擇新設定樣式，並啟用當機復原保護。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_current_summary_default
string.translation: %1$s settings style is active right now.
目前啟用的是 %1$s 設定樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_title
string.translation: 表情符號、貼圖與 GIF 分頁順序

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_summary
string.translation: Reorder the bottom tabs in Gboard\'s Emojis, stickers & GIFs panel.
重新排序 Gboard「表情符號、貼圖與 GIF」面板底部的分頁。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_header_summary
string.translation: Controls the bottom tab order used by Gboard\'s Emojis, stickers & GIFs panel.
控制 Gboard「表情符號、貼圖與 GIF」面板底部的分頁順序。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_error_title
string.translation: Emojis, stickers & GIFs tab order unavailable
表情符號、貼圖與 GIF 分頁順序無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_error_summary
string.translation: The footer order screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
底部分頁順序畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_reorder_summary
string.translation: Drag the handle to move tabs.

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_empty_summary
string.translation: No tabs available in this build.
這個 build 沒有可用的分頁。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_reset_confirm_message
string.translation: Restore the default Emojis, stickers & GIFs tab order?
要還原表情符號、貼圖與 GIF 的預設分頁順序嗎？

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_summary
string.translation: Add a manual Incognito toolbar button and configure clipboard and voice typing behavior.
新增手動無痕模式按鈕，並設定無痕模式下的剪貼簿與語音輸入行為。

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_enabled_summary
string.translation: Adds an Incognito button to the Access Point toolbar. Force-stop and restart Gboard for the change to take effect.
啟用後會在 Access Point 工具列中新增 Incognito 按鈕。強制關閉並重新啟動 Gboard 後生效。

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_clipboard_title
string.translation: 無痕模式時啟用剪貼簿

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_clipboard_summary
string.translation: Allow Gboard to process new system clipboard changes while incognito is active. Applies when the keyboard is reopened.
允許 Gboard 在無痕模式中處理新的系統剪貼簿內容。重新開啟鍵盤後套用。

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_voice_title
string.translation: 無痕模式時啟用語音輸入

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_voice_summary
string.translation: Allow voice typing while incognito is active. Google services or the network may still be used. Applies when the keyboard is reopened.
允許在無痕模式中使用語音輸入。Google 服務或網路仍可能被使用。重新開啟鍵盤後套用。

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_error_title
string.translation: 無痕模式設定無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_error_summary
string.translation: The incognito settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
無痕模式設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_summary
string.translation: Long-press designated letter keys to show Select all, Undo, Copy, Cut, Paste, and Redo actions.
長按指定字母鍵，顯示全選、復原、複製、剪下、貼上與重做操作。

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_error_title
string.translation: 長按編輯快捷鍵無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_error_summary
string.translation: The Long-Press Editing Shortcuts settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
長按編輯快捷鍵設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_enabled_summary
string.translation: Reopen the keyboard or switch layouts to fully apply changes.
重新叫出鍵盤或切換鍵盤版面後會完整套用變更。

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_globe_drag_title
string.translation: Hold and drag from globe key

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_globe_drag_summary
string.translation: Swipe from the globe key to A/Z/X/C/V/Y for editing actions.
從地球鍵滑到 A/Z/X/C/V/Y，執行編輯操作。

string.name: gboard_patches_bluetooth_microphone_summary
string.translation: 語音輸入->使用藍芽麥克風

string.name: gboard_patches_bluetooth_microphone_error_summary
string.translation: The Bluetooth microphone settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
藍芽麥克風設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_summary
string.translation: Controls whether Advanced Voice Typing is forced on.
控制是否強制啟用進階語音輸入。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_header_summary
string.translation: Voice typing -> Advanced features、 Add punctuation
語音輸入 -> 進階功能、 加入標點符號

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_error_title
string.translation: 進階語音輸入無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_error_summary
string.translation: The Advanced Voice Typing settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
進階語音輸入設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_enabled_summary
string.translation: Voice typing > Dictation type. Force-stop and restart Gboard for changes to take effect.
語音輸入 > 語音輸入類型。需強制停止並重新啟動Gboard才會生效

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_backend_summary
string.translation: Force-stop and restart Gboard after switching for changes to take effect
切換後須強制停止並重新啟動 Gboard 才會生效

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_zh_tw_punctuation_title
string.translation: Automatically Add Punctuation to Chinese Input
中文輸入自動添加標點符號

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_zh_tw_punctuation_summary
string.translation: Force-stop and restart Gboard for changes to take effect.
需要強制停止並重新啟動Gboard才會生效。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_supported_languages_summary
string.translation:
Only en-US supports the complete feature set.

English en-AU, en-CA, en-GB, en-IE, en-IN, en-SG, en-US

英文 en-AU、en-CA、en-GB、en-IE、en-IN、en-SG、en-US

法文 fr-BE、fr-CA、fr-CH、fr-FR
義大利文 it-CH、it-IT
日文 ja-JP
西班牙文 es-ES、es-US

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_github_star_title
string.translation: 在 GitHub 上支持這個專案 😊

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_github_star_summary
string.translation: This feature took a significant amount of time to build. If it helps you, please give the project a Star on GitHub.
這個功能投入了大量時間；如果對你有幫助，請到 GitHub 點個 Star。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_speech_services_status_summary
string.translation: Package: com.google.android.tts. Required for Advanced Voice Typing: install Speech Recognition & Synthesis and download the offline speech recognition model for every language you use. Tap to open its Google Play page.
套件：com.google.android.tts。啟用進階語音輸入的必要條件：必須安裝 Speech Recognition & Synthesis，並下載目前使用語言的離線語音辨識模型。點擊即可開啟 Google Play 頁面。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_speech_services_open_failed
string.translation: Unable to open the Speech Recognition & Synthesis Google Play page.
無法開啟 Speech Recognition & Synthesis 的 Google Play 頁面。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_downloaded_languages_loading_summary
string.translation: 正在讀取已下載的離線語言…

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_downloaded_languages_empty_summary
string.translation: 尚未偵測到已下載的離線語言。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_downloaded_languages_unsupported_summary
string.translation: This Android version cannot query downloaded offline languages.
這個 Android 版本不支援查詢已下載的離線語言。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_downloaded_languages_unavailable_summary
string.translation: No on-device speech recognition service is available.
找不到裝置端語音辨識服務。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_downloaded_languages_error_summary
string.translation: Unable to read downloaded offline languages. Check them in Live Transcribe.
無法讀取已下載的離線語言，請在即時轉錄中確認。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_live_transcribe_manage_title
string.translation: 使用即時轉錄管理語言

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_live_transcribe_manage_summary
string.translation: Use Google’s official Live Transcribe app to download the Speech Recognition & Synthesis offline recognition models required for Advanced Voice Typing. In Live Transcribe, open Settings → More settings → Primary language.\nTap to open Live Transcribe.
使用 Google 官方「即時轉錄」下載啟用進階語音輸入所需的 Speech Recognition & Synthesis 離線語音辨識模型。請在即時轉錄中開啟：設定 → 更多設定 → 主要語言。\n點擊即可開啟即時轉錄。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_live_transcribe_open_failed
string.translation: Unable to open Live Transcribe or its Google Play page.
無法開啟即時轉錄或其 Google Play 頁面。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_present_summary
string.translation: The currently installed %1$s meets the APK payload requirement for Advanced Voice Typing.
目前安裝的 %1$s 已符合進階語音輸入的 APK payload 需求。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_present_requirement_title
string.translation: 安裝檔需求（目前已符合）

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_present_requirement_summary
string.translation: No download is needed right now. For future updates or reinstalls, you must still use a bundle or split APKM and apply the patch in Morphe; a standalone APK cannot work.\nTap to view the APKMirror download page
目前不需要重新下載。日後更新或重新安裝時，仍必須使用 bundle 或 split APKM，並在 Morphe 中套用 patch；standalone APK 無法生效。\n點此查看 APKMirror 下載頁

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_absent_summary
string.translation: The currently installed %1$s does not contain libdictation_jni.so, which Advanced Voice Typing requires.
目前安裝的 %1$s 不包含進階語音輸入需要的 libdictation_jni.so。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_absent_requirement_title
string.translation: Get a bundle or split APKM
需要使用 bundle 或 split APKM

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_absent_requirement_summary
string.translation: Get a bundle or split APKM and apply the patch in Morphe; a standalone APK cannot work.\nTap to open the APKMirror download page
請重新取得 bundle 或 split APKM，並在 Morphe 中套用 patch；standalone APK 無法生效。\n點此開啟 APKMirror 下載頁

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_unknown_summary
string.translation: The installed APK files for the selected Gboard package could not be inspected.
無法檢查目前選取 Gboard package 的安裝 APK。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_unknown_requirement_summary
string.translation: It is currently unclear whether another download is needed. Verify that you used a bundle or split APKM and applied the patch in Morphe; a standalone APK cannot work.\nTap to view the APKMirror download page
目前無法判斷是否需要重新下載。請確認使用 bundle 或 split APKM，並在 Morphe 中套用 patch；standalone APK 無法生效。\n點此查看 APKMirror 下載頁

string.name: gboard_patches_ocr_summary
string.translation: Control the backend engine used for text recognition.
控制文字辨識的後端引擎。

string.name: gboard_patches_ocr_header_summary
string.translation: Official models must be downloaded through Google Play services.
需要透過 Google Play services 下載官方模型

string.name: gboard_patches_ocr_error_summary
string.translation: The OCR settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
OCR 設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_ocr_status_check_failed
string.translation: Unable to verify. Tap to download.

string.name: gboard_patches_flag_patch_error_summary
string.translation: The patch setting screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
Patch 設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_cursor_trackpad_summary
string.translation: Long-press the space bar to open a trackpad for moving the cursor freely through your text, with a lock mode for easier control.
長按空白鍵即可開啟觸控板，在文字中自由移動游標，並提供鎖定模式以便控制。

string.name: gboard_patches_access_points_menu_toggle_title
string.translation: Enable new Access Points menu style
啟用新版 Access Points 選單樣式

string.name: gboard_patches_split_keyboard_auto_summary
string.translation: Automatically uses split layout when Gboard determines there is enough space.
當 Gboard 判定空間足夠時，自動使用分離式鍵盤。

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_summary
string.translation: Customize which corners of the keyboard panel are rounded, and set the top and bottom radii separately.
自訂鍵盤面板哪些角落呈現圓角，並分別設定上方與下方半徑。

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_error_title
string.translation: 圓角鍵盤設定無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_error_summary
string.translation: The rounded keyboard settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
圓角鍵盤設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_enabled_summary
string.translation: Force-stop and restart Gboard for changes to take effect.
需強制停止並重新啟動 Gboard 才會生效。

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_mode_summary
string.translation: Choose which corners of the keyboard panel are rounded.
選擇鍵盤面板哪些角落呈現圓角。

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_top_radius_summary
string.translation: Set the radius for the upper corners.
設定上方兩個角落的半徑。

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_bottom_radius_summary
string.translation: Set the radius for the lower corners.
設定下方兩個角落的半徑。

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_radius_dialog_error
string.translation: Enter a whole number from 0 to 64.
請輸入 0 到 64 的整數。

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_reset_summary
string.translation: Restore the top and bottom corner radii to 32 dp.
將上方與下方圓角程度恢復為 32dp。

string.name: gboard_patches_rounded_keyboard_reset_confirm_message
string.translation: Restore the top and bottom corner radii to 32 dp?
要將上方與下方圓角程度恢復為 32dp 嗎？

string.name: gboard_patches_cursor_trackpad_preview_setting
string.translation: Long press spacebar for Trackpad setting
長按空白鍵啟用觸控板設定

string.name: gboard_patches_access_points_preview_legacy
string.translation: 舊版 Access Points 選單

string.name: gboard_patches_access_points_preview_redesigned
string.translation: 新版 Access Points 選單

string.name: gboard_patches_accessibility_preview_setting
string.translation: 顯示無障礙鍵盤配置設定

string.name: gboard_patches_spacebar_logo_summary
string.translation: Show an icon instead of the language name on the spacebar
在空白鍵顯示圖示並隱藏語言名稱

string.name: gboard_patches_spacebar_logo_icon_summary
string.translation: Choose the icon shown on the spacebar
選擇空白鍵上顯示的圖示

string.name: gboard_patches_spacebar_logo_color_summary
string.translation: Use the original icon color or choose a fixed color
使用圖示原色或選擇固定顏色

string.name: gboard_patches_spacebar_logo_error_summary
string.translation: The feature settings could not be loaded.
目前無法載入這項功能的設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_summary
string.translation: Open a browser-owned floating web page from Gboard. The selected browser supplies its cookies, login state, toolbar, and site compatibility.
從 Gboard 開啟由瀏覽器管理的懸浮網頁。Cookie、登入狀態、工具列與網站相容性皆由選定的瀏覽器提供。

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_enable_summary
string.translation: Force-stop and restart Gboard for changes to take effect.
強制停止並重新啟動 Gboard 後生效

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_start_page_summary
string.translation: Choose the HTTPS page opened whenever Web Search starts.
選擇每次啟動 Web Search 時開啟的 HTTPS 頁面。

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_custom_url_summary
string.translation: The complete HTTPS URL opened by the Web Search button.
Web Search 按鈕將開啟的完整 HTTPS 網址。

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_custom_url_error
string.translation: 請輸入完整的 HTTPS 網址。

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_height_summary
string.translation: Choose 50–100%. The default is 100%; supported browsers may still let you resize the tab.
可選擇 50–100%。預設為 100%；支援的瀏覽器仍可讓使用者調整分頁大小。

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_browser_summary
string.translation: Follow the system default or select an installed browser that supports Custom Tabs. Chrome, Edge, and Brave are recommended.
跟隨系統預設，或選擇已安裝且支援 Custom Tabs 的瀏覽器。推薦使用 Chrome、Edge、Brave。

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_test_summary
string.translation: Open the current page, browser, and height settings now.
立即使用目前的頁面、瀏覽器與高度設定開啟。

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_error_title
string.translation: 懸浮網頁搜尋設定無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_floating_web_search_error_summary
string.translation: The Floating Web Search settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
懸浮網頁搜尋設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_summary
string.translation: Transfer files with an FTP client on the local network
使用區域網路內的 FTP 用戶端傳輸檔案

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_enabled_summary
string.translation: Select a root folder before starting the server.
啟動伺服器前必須先選擇根目錄。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_screen_off_title
string.translation: Keep connection when screen is off

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_screen_off_summary
string.translation: If FTP disconnects after the screen turns off, set this app\'s battery policy to No restrictions.
若關螢幕後 FTP 會斷線，請將此應用程式的省電策略設為「無限制」。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_battery_settings_unavailable
string.translation: 無法開啟省電策略設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_port_summary
string.translation: FTP clients connect to this port.
FTP 用戶端使用此連接埠連線。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_passive_summary
string.translation: Each directory listing or file transfer uses one available data port. The default 10 ports already exceed this server\'s concurrency limits; a larger range does not increase transfer speed.
每次瀏覽目錄或傳輸檔案都會使用一個可用的資料連接埠。預設 10 個已高於此伺服器的同時連線上限；擴大範圍不會提升傳輸速度。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_root_summary
string.translation: Only this folder and its contents are shared.
只分享此資料夾及其內容。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_all_files_required
string.translation: Required before the /sdcard server can start
啟動 /sdcard 伺服器前必須授權

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_all_files_required_message
string.translation: All files access is required to share /sdcard.
分享 /sdcard 必須授予所有檔案存取權。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_all_files_settings_unavailable
string.translation: All files access settings are unavailable.
無法開啟所有檔案存取權設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_read_only_summary
string.translation: Prevent FTP clients from changing files.
禁止 FTP 用戶端變更檔案。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_password_summary
string.translation: Tap to set exactly six lowercase letters.
點擊設定恰好六位英文小寫字母。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_password_invalid
string.translation: Password must contain exactly six lowercase letters.
密碼必須是恰好六位英文小寫字母。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_anonymous_summary
string.translation: Clients can sign in as anonymous without a password.
用戶端可使用 anonymous 帳號登入，不需要密碼。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_regenerate_summary
string.translation: Disconnects existing sessions when the server reloads.
伺服器重新載入時會中斷現有連線。

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_error_title
string.translation: 無法使用 FTP 設定

string.name: gboard_patches_lan_ftp_error_summary
string.translation: The server remains stopped because its settings could not be loaded safely.
無法安全載入設定，因此伺服器維持停止。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_summary
string.translation: Export or restore all Patches settings
匯出或還原全部 Patches 設定

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_export_failed
string.translation: 無法匯出 Patches 設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_done
string.translation: Patches settings restored. Restart Gboard to apply every change.
已還原 Patches 設定。請重新啟動 Gboard 以套用全部變更。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_done_mirror_pending
string.translation: Patches settings restored locally. Restart Gboard to rebuild unavailable remote settings.
已還原本機 Patches 設定。請重新啟動 Gboard，以重建目前無法使用的遠端設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_failed
string.translation: The selected backup is invalid or could not be processed.
所選備份無效或無法處理。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_flag_backend_proto
string.translation: Gboard currently uses the new PB flag-store format.
目前 Gboard Flag 後端使用新版 PB 格式。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_flag_backend_proto_with_legacy
string.translation: Both the new PB format and legacy XML format currently exist. It cannot be determined which format Gboard will ultimately read.
目前同時存在新版 PB 與舊版 XML，無法確認 Gboard 最後會讀取哪一種格式。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_flag_backend_legacy
string.translation: Gboard currently uses the legacy XML flag-store format.
目前 Gboard Flag 後端使用舊版 XML 格式。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_flag_backend_not_created
string.translation: No persisted flag store exists yet; the backend cannot be determined from disk
目前尚未建立持久化 flag store，無法只從磁碟判定 backend

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_flag_backend_unavailable
string.translation: Gboard is not ready for a storage query
Gboard 尚未準備好接受儲存空間查詢

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_preview_summary
string.translation: 新增 %1$d · 變更 %2$d · 移除 %3$d · 不變 %4$d

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_result_success
string.translation: Restored %1$d modules and verified %2$d backup keys. Restart Gboard to apply every change.
已還原 %1$d 個模組，並驗證 %2$d 個備份 key。請重新啟動 Gboard 以套用全部變更。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_result_mirror_pending
string.translation: Restored %1$d modules and verified %2$d backup keys. Some live mirrors are unavailable; restart Gboard to rebuild them.
已還原 %1$d 個模組，並驗證 %2$d 個備份 key。部分即時鏡像目前不可用；請重新啟動 Gboard 重建。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_result_partial
string.translation: Restored %1$d modules and %2$d keys; %3$d modules failed. Successful modules were kept.
已還原 %1$d 個模組與 %2$d 個 key；%3$d 個模組失敗。成功模組的變更已保留。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_result_failed
string.translation: No selected module was restored. Review each module below.
沒有任何已選模組完成還原，請查看下方各模組結果。

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_restore_result_no_keys
string.translation: No stored keys in this module
這個模組沒有已儲存的 key

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_status_success
string.translation: 模組已還原並通過驗證

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_status_previous_values_restored
string.translation: Restore failed; previous values were restored
還原失敗；已恢復先前設定

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_key_removed
string.translation: Removed because it was absent from the complete backup
完整備份中不存在，因此已移除

string.name: gboard_patches_backup_key_failed
string.translation: Did not match the backup value
寫入後未對應到備份值

string.name: gboard_flag_store_replacement_export_section
string.translation: 原始 flag store 匯出

string.name: gboard_flag_store_replacement_export_done
string.translation: 已匯出原始 flag store 檔案。

string.name: gboard_flag_store_replacement_export_failed
string.translation: Unable to export this flag-store file.
無法匯出這個 flag store 檔案。

string.name: gboard_flag_store_replacement_choose_title
string.translation: 選擇 PB 或 XML 檔案

string.name: gboard_flag_store_replacement_invalid_name
string.translation: The selected file does not have a supported canonical Gboard flag-store name.
所選檔案不是支援的 Gboard flag store 標準檔名。

string.name: gboard_flag_store_replacement_stage_failed
string.translation: The replacement file was rejected or could not be prepared.
覆蓋檔案遭拒絕或無法準備套用。

string.name: gboard_flag_store_replacement_apply_confirm_title
string.translation: 確定要還原 Gboard flag store 嗎？

string.name: gboard_flag_store_replacement_apply_confirm_message
string.translation: The original values will be overwritten.
原始值將會直接被覆蓋

string.name: gboard_flag_store_diff_summary
string.translation: Current values: %1$d · Replacement values: %2$d · Changed: %3$d · Added: %4$d · Removed: %5$d
目前值：%1$d · 覆蓋檔值：%2$d · 變更：%3$d · 新增：%4$d · 移除：%5$d

string.name: gboard_flag_store_diff_identical
string.translation: The replacement contains the same typed values as the current file.
覆蓋檔與目前檔案包含相同的 typed value。

string.name: gboard_flag_store_diff_current_failed
string.translation: Unable to read the current flag-store file for comparison.
無法讀取目前的 flag store 進行比較。

string.name: gboard_flag_store_diff_decode_failed
string.translation: Unable to completely decode this flag store, so it cannot be used.
無法完整解碼這份 flag store，因此無法使用。

string.name: gboard_patches_calculator_summary
string.translation: Type an arithmetic expression in any text field. Its result appears in Gboard’s suggestion row and can replace the expression with one tap.
直接在任何文字欄輸入算式，答案會出現在 Gboard 推薦列；點一下即可用答案取代算式。

string.name: gboard_patches_calculator_enable_summary
string.translation: Shows results for complete arithmetic expressions the next time the keyboard opens.
下一次開啟鍵盤時，為完整四則算式顯示答案推薦。

string.name: gboard_patches_calculator_usage_summary
string.translation: Type a complete expression such as 2+3×4 in the current app. Tap the result above the keyboard to replace the expression with 14, or long-press the result to copy it.
在目前 App 輸入完整算式，例如 2+3×4。點選鍵盤上方的 14 會以答案取代算式；長按答案則可直接複製。

string.name: gboard_patches_calculator_limits_summary
string.translation:
Expression length: Up to 128 characters; rejected before normalization.
Binary operations: Up to 63.
Parentheses depth: Up to 16 levels.
Internal precision: 16 significant digits, HALF_EVEN.
Display precision: Up to 3 decimal places, HALF_UP.
Large numbers: Scientific notation from 10¹².
Operators: + - * / − × ÷
Parentheses: Supports () and full-width （） from Traditional Chinese Gboard.

算式長度：最多 128 字元，正規化前即拒絕
二元運算：最多 63 次
括號深度：最多 16 層
內部精度：16 位有效數字，HALF_EVEN
顯示精度：最多小數 3 位，HALF_UP
大數顯示：達 10¹² 改用科學記號
運算符號：+ - * / − × ÷
括號：支援 () 與繁中 Gboard 實際輸出的 （）

string.name: gboard_patches_calculator_error_summary
string.translation: The calculator settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
計算機設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。
